Introduction

Hello, and welcome.

Today’s story is about a new Nintendo game.

The news is simple and a little surprising.

A big game is cheaper now.

And the old Switch still works well with it.

That is why many fans are smiling today.

We will use easy English and short sentences.

Practice

Is the game cheaper now?

Yes, it is cheaper now.

Is the lower price at Best Buy or at a supermarket?

It is at Best Buy.

Does the old Switch still work well with the game?

Yes, it does.

Is the $10 pack for the first Switch or for Switch 2?

It is for Switch 2.

Why are many fans happy or surprised?

The game is cheaper, and the old Switch still works well.

Summary

Nice work today.

This story had one clear idea.

The game costs less now.

The old Switch still works well.

And Switch 2 players can add something later.

That gives players a simple choice.

Thank you for learning with me today.
